headline: Best early Pals to catch first
title: Best Pals to Catch First in Palworld | Early Game Guide | Palworld Guide
video_script: Just started Palworld? Catch these Pals first. Cattiva is the best first catch, it helps around your base and lets you carry more. Foxparks is your first Kindling Pal for cooking and smelting, and a great early fighter. Lifmunk works your first crafting bench with Handiwork. Lamball gives you Wool at your Ranch. And Vixy digs up useful items like Pal Spheres and arrows by itself. Who was your first catch? Comment below!
description: Best early Pals in Palworld 1.0: Cattiva (base helper, extra carry weight), Foxparks (first Kindling Pal), Lifmunk (Handiwork), Lamball (Wool at the Ranch) and Vixy (digs up items like Pal Spheres and arrows).
